sentences.text: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana

**Scheme Brief Description:** Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning

**Detailed Description:** Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &amp;quot;Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana&amp;quot; for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015. The main objective of the scheme to provides financial assistance to the children of sanitation workers in India for higher education.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - Financial assistance provided according to the below table ClassesBoy Students (Annual Scholarship amount)Girl Students (Annual Scholarship amount)Class I to V₹500/-₹750/-Class VI to VIII₹750/-₹1,000/-Class IX to XII₹1,000/-₹1,500/-Graduation ( BA, BSe, BCom)₹1,500/-₹2,000/-Post Graduation (MA , MSe, M.Com, Diploma)₹2,500/-₹3,000/-Pursuing graduate level professional course₹3,000/-₹4,000/-Studying for professional level, doing PhD or research work₹4,000/-₹5,000/-

**Application Process:** **Unregistered Applicant :** 1. All the applicant have to visit the official [website](https://cglabour.nic.in) Chhattisgarh Labour Department. 1. On the home page click on "[Apply](https://cglabour.nic.in/Departments.aspx?id=4)" under "Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board".1. Enter the following details 1. Select Group Name : "Asangathit Marmakaar Mandal" 1. Select Service : "Asangathit Shramik Panjikaran" 1. What do you want to do : "Aavedan" 1. Click next. 1. Check the eligibility criteria for registration in Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board and click next. 1. Fill out the online "Registration form". 1. Submit.  **Already Registered Applicant :** 1. All the applicant have to visit the official [website](https://cglabour.nic.in) Chhattisgarh Labour Department. 1. On the home page click on "[Apply](https://cglabour.nic.in/Departments.aspx?id=4)" under "Chhattisgarh Unorganized Workers State Social Security Board".1. Enter the following details 1. Select Group Name : "Asangathit Marmakaar Mandal" 1. Select Service : "Yojana" 1. What do you want to do : "Aavedan" 1. Click next. 1. Select your district name and provide old/new registration number and click next. 1. Select the scheme name. 1. Fill out the online with required details. 1. Submit.
